data.llm_justification: The rule-based model underweights the dangerous combination of a 35.1% BL velocity collapse alongside a critically low PNS answer rate of 20.5% — together these suggest the seller is becoming unreachable to buyers precisely as inbound interest is declining, a compounding churn accelerant. Additionally, zero hotlead activity despite 4678 clickstream events and 396 BLs indicates a severe engagement-to-conversion breakdown that the base score treats as isolated flags rather than a reinforcing pattern of disengagement.
llm_interactions: BL velocity drop (-35.1% MoM) × low PNS answer rate (20.5%): declining inbound paired with buyer unreachability creates a self-reinforcing churn loop
High clickstream activity (4678 events) × zero hotleads: seller is browsing but not converting, suggesting passive disengagement rather than active selling intent
High reply rate (559.1%) × low PNS rate (20.5%): seller responds to text BLs but ignores phone calls, indicating selective engagement that may frustrate high-intent buyers who prefer calls
TYPE_B Gradual Drift trajectory × compound signal severity: gradual drift masks the acute severity of the PNS and velocity signals, causing the rule-based model to underreact
